# Rangular

> Rangular is a standalone transpiler: you write Angular-style code — TypeScript classes with @Component decorators and HTML-like templates — and it compiles to React Native .tsx (Hermes makes the bytecode; Rangular never emits it, never forks Angular). Simple template blocks compile to pre-polished Rangular Material primitives driven by design tokens, state is plain class fields (mutated fields become useState in the generated output), and every compiler error is a coded diagnostic with a concrete fix suggestion. Current state: Stages 0+1, 2 and 2.5 done — static components, {{ interpolation }}, [prop] bindings, (event) bindings, *ngIf, *ngFor, interactive previews, plus the vibe-coding layer (this file, AGENTS.md, generated catalog, recipe cards, --json diagnostics). DI/lifecycle wiring is Stage 3; see the delta summary below for what is NOT supported yet.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): What Rangular is, block diagram, stage status, build/test/run commands
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Rules for AI agents working in this repo — repo map, commands, golden rules (never edit generated files; capability = code + tests + example + recipe card + catalog)
- [Catalog (Markdown)](catalog.md): Every usable template tag, event, primitive prop, token scale and diagnostic code — generated from the code
- [Catalog (JSON)](catalog.json): The same catalog, machine-readable

## Docs

- [Block diagram](docs/BLOCK_DIAGRAM.md): The architecture in layers — source, compiler, runtime, generated RN project, existing RN toolchain
- [UI polish system](docs/UI_POLISH.md): How generated UI stays polished — tokens only, pre-polished primitives, compiler defaults, screenshot proof
- [Vibe-coding layer](docs/VIBE_CODING.md): What makes this repo AI-buildable, plus the full delta tables (Rangular vs Angular, Rangular vs React)

## The delta in 30 seconds

Same as Angular: @Component/@Input/@Output, separate .html templates, {{ }} / [ ] / ( ) / *ngIf / *ngFor syntax, class fields as state, methods as actions, built-in pipes (uppercase, lowercase, titlecase, json).
NOT supported yet (do not use): [(ngModel)] and forms, real two-way binding ([(x)] degrades to a one-way prop binding), routing, NgModules, constructor DI / @Injectable wiring (Stage 3), lifecycle hooks actually being called (Stage 3), animations, SSR, RxJS Observables in source, custom @Pipe classes, *ngIf else/then (use two elements with opposite conditions), CSS beyond the element/.class subset.
Not React: no JSX, no hooks, no useState in source — source is classes + HTML templates; events are (click), never onPress; the generated .tsx is output, never edited. Full tables: [docs/VIBE_CODING.md](docs/VIBE_CODING.md).

## Examples (each has a recipe card)

- [Hello — recipe card](examples/hello/README.md): Static screen, {{ interpolation }}, [prop] binding, component styles — the smallest Rangular component
- [Counter — recipe card](examples/counter/README.md): Events + state — (click) handlers, methods mutating fields become useState, *ngIf message
- [Inbox — recipe card](examples/inbox/README.md): Lists — *ngFor over a literal array with keyed rows, *ngIf empty state
- [Profile — recipe card](examples/profile/README.md): Composition — card + avatar row + toggle button with ternary label + posts list; the Stage 2.5 proof-test example, written from these docs alone

## Packages

- [@rangular/compiler](packages/compiler/src/index.ts): Compiler entry point — template/expression parsers, @Component extractor, CSS subset, codegen, preview renderer, catalog generator
- [@rangular/cli](packages/cli/src/cli.ts): The rangular CLI — build, ast, preview, catalog; build/preview accept --json
- [@rangular/runtime](packages/runtime/src/index.ts): Pure-TS helpers for generated apps — EventEmitter, signal(), DI Container, pipe()
- [@rangular/ui tokens](packages/ui/src/tokens.ts): Rangular Material design tokens — spacing, radius, type scale, light/dark colour roles
- [@rangular/ui primitives](packages/ui/src/primitives.tsx): Pre-polished RN primitives (RgScreen, RgAppbar, RgCard, RgButton, RgText, RgList, RgRow, RgFab) shipped as source into generated apps
- [@rangular/ui README](packages/ui/README.md): What ships from the UI package and why primitives are excluded from the repo build

## How to build a screen

1. Write the component class: `x.component.ts` with `@Component({ selector: 'app-x', templateUrl: './x.component.html' })`, state as literal-initialised class fields, actions as methods that assign `this.field`.
2. Write the template: `x.component.html` using only catalog tags — text in `p`/`span`/`h1`–`h3`, interaction via `(click)="method()"`, visibility via `*ngIf`, lists via `*ngFor="let item of items; let i = index"`.
3. Compile: `node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js build x.component.ts --out x.component.tsx --json`
4. Read the diagnostics from the JSON: each has a `code`, source `line`/`column`, and a `fix` — apply the fix to the source (never to the generated .tsx).
5. Render the preview: `node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js preview x.component.ts --out preview.html`
6. Open `preview.html` and check the screen — it is interactive: (click) handlers run, *ngIf/*ngFor respond to state. Iterate from step 1.
7. If the screen becomes a shipped example, it is not done until it also has: a recipe card (`examples/<name>/README.md` in the fixed Intent / Source / What it compiles to / Rules used / Common mistakes shape), tests, and a regenerated catalog (`node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js catalog --out .`) — see golden rule 2 in AGENTS.md.
